GreyRadius Consulting

Boutique strategy and growth consulting firm (founded 2017) with offices in Delhi, Dubai, Singapore and Brussels. We help founders, CXOs and boards with market entry, GTM execution, feasibility and TEV studies, opportunity assessment, fundraising and AI transformation across India, the Middle East, Southeast Asia and Africa. Every engagement is grounded in actionable plan with handson execution Contact: sales@greyradius.com

Services

Opportunity Assessment: Market sizing, demand validation and a go/defer/kill recommendation
Feasibility & TEV: Bankable feasibility studies, techno-economic viability reports and DPRs for lenders and boards
Market Entry Execution: Entity setup, regulatory navigation, partnerships and first-customer acquisition
GTM Execution-as-a-Service: We design and run the first 90 days of the go-to-market motion
Pitchbook & Fundraising: Investor-interview-backed pitch decks, valuation and fundraising process
AI Consulting & Transformation: Use-case prioritisation and a live pilot in 4-6 weeks

Industries focused and geography across technology, BFSI, energy, CPG/FMCG, healthcare, industrials, education and more
